summary: Key and Visual Arts' Air is a story-heavy visual novel with adult-original and later all-ages routes, console/mobile ports, and a modern Steam release with English support.

entries.title: Air
entries.definitive_edition: 2025 Steam release for current localized play; original Windows adult release for historical comparison

emulation.notes: Native Steam PC route is preferred.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Steam release with route/language/content state documented

primary.why: The Steam version is the current official PC route with English/Japanese/Simplified Chinese subtitles, Japanese voice, remastered visuals, and the First Sky Chapter side story. The original 2000 Windows adult release is historically distinct and should be documented separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam release for the main route. Record build, language/subtitle, voice, route/chapter, CG/music mode, text speed, controller or mouse input, and whether the original adult Windows release or Switch/Vita routes were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for strict version-history comparison.
secondary.why: The current Steam route is accessible and localized, but not identical to the original adult PC release.

secondary.exclusive_content: All-ages console routes and side-story lineage
secondary.why: Steam is the current PC/localization route.

all_releases.reason: secondary: historically exact but not the best current localized route.

all_releases.platform: Dreamcast / PlayStation 2 / PSP / Vita / Switch / mobile ports
all_releases.fidelity: All-ages console/mobile routes with version differences.
Current official PC route with English support, voice, remastered visuals, and First Sky Chapter.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The modern localized/all-ages route and original adult Windows release differ in content and presentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether the run uses the new side-story content and do not conflate with unrelated games named Air.
